name: eol-time
description: Log hours and run your timer in EOL Time (time.eol.agency, EOL's Harvest replacement) from Claude: the EOL Time MCP server plus two skills.

api_key.title: EOL Time API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://time.eol.agency/settings/api-keys. A key starting eol_time_ can only track your time (recommended); one starting eol_full_ can do everything you can in EOL Time.
